attempts.prompt:
Stylized chunky toy-like game character for an auto-battler, simple readable shapes, oversized head, hands and feet, thick limbs, flat soft hand-painted colours with gentle shading, matte, no fine texture, no noise, no patterns, no small ornaments, no text. Full body, neutral A-pose with arms about 35 degrees from the body and legs slightly apart, calm face looking straight ahead. Straight-on camera at chest height with minimal perspective, even soft light, plain flat light-grey background #E6E6E6, no ground shadow, no scenery, no effects. The whole character is inside the frame with margin on every side. Design: Shieldbearer, a human tank. Stocky knight in plain plate with one oversized tower shield. About 3.0 heads tall; stocky, wide shoulders, short legs. Only three colours plus skin: steel grey #8E99A6, royal blue #2F5FB3, warm gold #E0B040. Features: rounded bucket helmet with a single horizontal eye slit and a short blue plume; plain smooth plate armour with a blue tabard showing one gold sun circle on the chest; big rounded gauntlets and boots. Right hand: empty, open gauntlet. Left hand: oversized rectangular tower shield, almost as tall as he is, blue face with a gold sun circle, gold rim, held upright at his left side with its bottom edge on the ground. FRONT VIEW. The character faces the viewer directly.
Output one square 1024x1024 PNG image. Treat each gold sun circle as one plain filled circle, with no rays, engraving or pattern. The shield is on the viewer's right, clear of the torso. Preserve only the specified large simple parts. No extra belts, buckles, pouches, rivets, ornaments, edge outlines or floor shadow.
defects: Approximately four helmet-heads tall rather than three
Mottled surfaces and localized glossy highlights
